subject.title: [Feature]: Clickable file links in chat with file viewer sidebar; workspace navigator previews any in-root file

question: Should Control UI/Gateway widen `sessions.files.get` from transcript-touched files to any fs-safe in-workspace file and add chat file-link UI in core now?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the requested behavior deliberately changes the workspace file-read scope and visible chat UX, and the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Implement bounded core viewer
options.body: Add file-link parsing and a sidebar-backed viewer in Control UI, with `sessions.files.get` serving only fs-safe in-root files under the existing preview cap.

options.title: Keep transcript-only previews
options.body: Preserve the current narrower read surface and leave browser-only files as copy/browse-only until a stronger security or UX case is accepted.

options.title: Split the work
options.body: Land explicit markdown file-link handling first, then separately decide whether workspace browser previews may read untouched in-root files.

recommendation.title: Implement bounded core viewer
recommendation.body: Add file-link parsing and a sidebar-backed viewer in Control UI, with `sessions.files.get` serving only fs-safe in-root files under the existing preview cap.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature request and have recent adjacent Control UI link-preview context.
